note: Rough reference for the AI's battle timing. Approximate, edit freely; the model only uses it to order and time actions. speed = in-game movement speed stat (higher is faster); range and radius in tiles; durations in seconds.

Barbarian King.ability: Iron Fist: faster and stronger for a few seconds, summons barbarians

Archer Queen.ability: Royal Cloak: invisible and stronger for a few seconds

Grand Warden.ability: Eternal Tome: invulnerability aura for the army for a few seconds

Heal.use: on the tanking group while it fights

Rage.use: on the army while it reaches defenses

Jump.use: on a wall the army must cross

Freeze.use: on the defenses the army is facing
